items.title: Clem Raymond Interview, 1958-08-25
items.q: I know John played trumpet. See, he was on the cold weather side with me.

ctx.x: The real, the family name is Porter. Oh, yeah? There was Jolly once on one of those records. He said, I've changed the name around. Basically calling him Porter King. I called him the King Porter. Oh, bright-looking fellas. But his real, the real name is Porter. Porter, yeah. And you said one played piano? I don't know. I played trumpet, and another one.
I know John played trumpet. See, he was on the cold weather side with me. For a while, I was glad he met yesterday, too. Did you ever get any data on William Nicholson? Professor Nicholson?
No, except the fastest over there. He studied piano with him for a while.
